rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone is focused on something or engrossed in it.

example.english: I was intent on my book and didn't even hear the phone ring.
example.traditional: 我睇書嗰陣好專心，連電話響都聽唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 syu1 go2 zan6 hou2 zyun1 sam1 lin4 din6 waa6 hoeng2 dou1 teng1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this for being single-mindedly set on achieving or doing a particular action, especially before a verb.

example.english: They are intent on getting into medical school and study every day.
example.traditional: 佢一心要考入醫學院，日日都溫書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 sam1 jiu3 haau2 jap6 ji1 hok6 jyun2 jat6 jat6 dou1 wan1 syu1

rows.note: Use this when “determined” means firm and unwavering about a decision or course of action.

example.english: We are intent on carrying it through now that we have decided.
example.traditional: 我哋既然決定咗，就會堅決做落去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gei3 jin4 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zau6 wui5 gin1 kyut3 zou6 lok6 heoi3
